chunks: And he was asked about the ʿaqiqah: when it is slaughtered, should its bones be broken? He said: “Yes, its bones should be broken, its meat should be cut up, and after the slaughter you may do with it whatever you wish.”

key_terms.الْعَقِيقَةِ: the sacrificial animal offered for a newborn child

ai.seo_question: Should the bones of the ʿaqiqah animal be broken after slaughter?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the handling of the ʿaqiqah animal after slaughter. It states that its bones may be broken and its meat cut up, and that one has discretion regarding its use after the slaughter.
